description: Inventory of other fixed-budget gradient-descent fits in src/ and their convergence on canonical inputs, with the effect on each reported number or classification. Plan items 5-6.
findings: Five fixed-budget GD fits, none frozen: propensity (500/0.1), _fit_cox (300/0.05), baselines._fit_logistic (300/0.05), NCO linear regression (300/0.1), calibration (500/0.1).
Cox fits materially unconverged: log-HR unadjusted -0.377 vs -0.641, adjusted -0.499 vs -0.953, ps-weighted -0.586 vs -0.957 (CoxBaseline identical to adjusted).
Outcome regression materially unconverged (-0.083 vs -0.159). IPCW-AIPW immaterial (-0.158 vs -0.158). IPW has no fit.
Sealed internal reference uses the same unadjusted_cox (code check only; value not opened).
NCO CD8 regression converged enough (-0.1144 vs exact -0.1150, 'uncertain' both). Calibration immaterial (slope 0.573 vs 0.583).
